title: OxO2: Ontology Xref Service software
description: OxO2 is EMBL-EBI's SSSOM-compliant ontology mapping (cross-reference) service: a dataload that downloads SSSOM mapping sets, infers cross-set mappings with the Nemo rules engine and indexes them into Apache Solr, a REST API that is backwards compatible with OxO version 1, and a web interface. This record archives the OxO2 software source code; mapping data releases are independent of software releases.
